description: Fix konsolidasi detail: enable detail click in konsolidasi mode (frontend + backend). Currently when kode_kantor is empty (konsolidasi mode), the linkCell function returns plain text instead of a clickable link, and the backend getMigrasiBucketDetailActual and getMigrasiBucketDetailOLunas reject konsolidasi requests. Also add pagination of 20 items per page in the detail modal.
steps: FRONTEND - pages/migrasi_bucket.php: In the linkCell function (around line 432 in the JS section), remove the condition `gIsKonsol` that prevents rendering links. Currently: `if(to_bucket === 'RUNOFF' || gIsKonsol) return numHTML(n);` - change it to: `if(to_bucket === 'RUNOFF') return numHTML(n);` so konsolidasi mode cells are also clickable.

BACKEND - api/controllers/KolekController.php: In getMigrasiBucketDetailActual (starts ~line 1380), remove the early return that blocks konsolidasi. Currently: `if ($kc===null || $kc==='000') { return sendResponse(400, ...); }`. Instead, when $kc is null, query ALL branches (exclude kode_cabang 000) - same pattern used in computeOSForDate. Modify the SQL to conditionally filter by kode_kantor or include all non-000 branches.

BACKEND - api/controllers/KolekController.php: In getMigrasiBucketDetailOLunas (starts ~line 1460), apply the same fix - remove the early return blocking konsolidasi and modify SQL to work without specific kode_kantor, using the same pattern (exclude kode_cabang 000).

FRONTEND - pages/migrasi_bucket.php: Add client-side pagination of 20 items per page in the renderDetailTable function. Add pagination controls (prev/next/page numbers) below the modal table. Only render 20 rows at a time based on the current page, while keeping the full dataset in memory for filtering/sorting.
BACKEND - Note: For REALISASI type, the konsolidasi block can remain (it requires specific branch) since the user only mentioned konsolidasi for the ACTUAL/O_LUNAS paths.
acceptance_criteria: In konsolidasi mode (no kode_kantor selected), clicking a cell value in the matrix opens the detail modal
The detail modal shows data with pagination of 20 items per page
Pagination controls appear below the table with prev/next navigation
Filtering and sorting still work correctly with pagination
Backend returns data for konsolidasi mode (all branches except 000) for ACTUAL and O_LUNAS detail types
PHP syntax check passes on both modified files
